svg.title: Batch mixer — 30 degree view
svg.desc: Framed batch mixer with inlet chutes, a weighing hopper with an amber rim, a cylindrical mixing chamber, circular inspection cover with two swept windows, pneumatic regulator and bottom discharge. Simplified orthographic illustration based on the supplied workplace photograph; unseen geometry is inferred.
